name: Aadhaar Online Services
description: Navigate UIDAI Aadhaar portal for common services like address update, mobile update, and download.

commonSteps.name: UIDAI Home Page
commonSteps.description: The main landing page of the UIDAI website
commonSteps.nextAction: Look for and tap on 'My Aadhaar' or 'Aadhaar Services' in the navigation menu
commonSteps.targetElement: My Aadhaar menu item or Aadhaar Services link
commonSteps.tips: The main navigation is usually at the top of the page

commonSteps.name: Aadhaar Services Menu
commonSteps.description: The dropdown or page showing available Aadhaar services
commonSteps.nextAction: Select the specific service you need from the list
commonSteps.targetElement: The service option that matches your requirement
commonSteps.tips: Common services include Update Aadhaar (for address/mobile changes) and Download Aadhaar

commonSteps.name: Aadhaar Update Portal
commonSteps.description: The Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) for updating Aadhaar details online
commonSteps.nextAction: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number in the input field
commonSteps.tips: Make sure to enter all 12 digits correctly

commonSteps.name: CAPTCHA Verification
commonSteps.description: Security CAPTCHA that needs to be filled manually
commonSteps.nextAction: Enter the CAPTCHA text shown in the image
commonSteps.tips: Civora cannot solve CAPTCHAs for you — please read and enter the characters yourself

commonSteps.name: Request OTP
commonSteps.description: Screen to request OTP on registered mobile number
commonSteps.nextAction: Tap 'Send OTP' to receive a verification code on your registered mobile
commonSteps.tips: OTP will be sent to your Aadhaar-registered mobile number

commonSteps.name: Enter OTP
commonSteps.description: Screen where user enters the OTP received on their phone
commonSteps.nextAction: Enter the OTP you received on your mobile and tap Verify/Submit
commonSteps.tips: Check your SMS for the OTP. If not received, you can tap Resend OTP

subWorkflows.name: Update Address
subWorkflows.description: Change your residential address on Aadhaar card

steps.name: Select Address Update
steps.description: Choose Address as the field to update
steps.nextAction: Select the checkbox next to 'Address' and tap Proceed/Next
steps.tips: Only select 'Address' — do not select other fields unless you want to update them too

steps.name: Fill New Address
steps.description: Enter your new address details
steps.nextAction: Fill in your new address starting with the Care of / House Number field
steps.targetElement: The first empty required address field
steps.tips: Fill all mandatory fields marked with *. Use the exact address as it appears on your proof document

steps.name: Upload Address Proof
steps.description: Upload a supporting document as proof of new address
steps.nextAction: Select your document type from the dropdown, then upload a clear scan/photo of your proof document
steps.targetElement: Document Type dropdown, then Choose File button
steps.tips: Accepted: Passport, Bank Statement (≤3 months old), Utility Bill, Rental Agreement. File must be JPG/PNG/PDF under 2MB

steps.name: Review Address Details
steps.description: Review the updated address before submission
steps.nextAction: Compare old and new address, then tap Submit/Confirm
steps.tips: Double-check your new address matches your proof document exactly

steps.name: Confirmation & URN
steps.description: Success confirmation with tracking number
steps.nextAction: Note down or save your Update Request Number (URN) for future tracking
steps.tips: Take a screenshot! You'll need this URN to track your update. Address updates typically take 5-10 days

subWorkflows.name: Update Mobile Number
subWorkflows.description: Link a new mobile number to your Aadhaar
requiredDocuments: Visit Aadhaar Enrolment Centre required for mobile update

steps.name: Mobile Update Information
steps.description: Information about mobile number update process
steps.nextAction: Note: Mobile number can only be updated by visiting an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre. Tap 'Book Appointment' or 'Locate Enrolment Centre'
steps.targetElement: Book Appointment or Locate Centre link
steps.tips: Mobile number cannot be changed online — you must visit a centre in person with your original Aadhaar and a new mobile

steps.name: Book Appointment
steps.description: Book an appointment at an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre
steps.nextAction: Select your city/state and search for nearby Aadhaar Enrolment Centres
steps.tips: Choose a centre near you. Most centres accept walk-ins too, but booking saves waiting time

steps.name: Select Centre & Time
steps.description: Choose a specific centre and appointment time
steps.nextAction: Select a centre from the list, pick a date and time slot, then tap Book
steps.targetElement: Book Slot / Select button for your preferred centre
steps.tips: Carry original Aadhaar, valid ID proof, and your new mobile phone to the appointment

steps.name: Appointment Confirmation
steps.description: Appointment booking confirmation
steps.nextAction: Save or screenshot your appointment details — Booking ID, Date, Time, and Centre Address
steps.tips: Reach 15 minutes early. Carry: Aadhaar card, ID proof, new mobile phone (for OTP verification at centre)

subWorkflows.name: Update Date of Birth
subWorkflows.description: Correct or update your date of birth on Aadhaar

steps.name: Select Date of Birth
steps.description: Choose Date of Birth as the field to update
steps.nextAction: Select the checkbox next to 'Date of Birth' and tap Proceed/Next
steps.tips: DOB can only be updated once online. Make sure your proof document has the correct date

steps.name: Enter New Date of Birth
steps.description: Enter the correct date of birth
steps.nextAction: Enter your correct date of birth using the date picker or input fields (DD/MM/YYYY format)
steps.targetElement: Date of Birth input field or date picker
steps.tips: Enter the date exactly as it appears on your proof document. Format: DD/MM/YYYY

steps.name: Upload DOB Proof
steps.description: Upload a supporting document proving your date of birth
steps.nextAction: Select your DOB proof type from the dropdown, then upload a clear scan/photo
steps.targetElement: Document Type dropdown, then Choose File button
steps.tips: Accepted: Birth Certificate, Passport, SSLC/10th Marksheet, PAN Card. File must be JPG/PNG/PDF under 2MB

steps.name: Review DOB Update
steps.description: Review the date of birth change before submission
steps.nextAction: Verify old and new DOB are correct, then tap Submit/Confirm
steps.tips: Carefully verify — DOB update is allowed only once via the online portal

steps.name: Confirmation & URN
steps.description: Success confirmation with tracking number
steps.nextAction: Note down or save your Update Request Number (URN) for future tracking
steps.tips: Take a screenshot! DOB updates may take 7-15 days to reflect. Track status using your URN

subWorkflows.name: Update Name
subWorkflows.description: Correct or change your name on Aadhaar card
requiredDocuments: Marriage Certificate (for name change after marriage)

steps.name: Select Name Update
steps.description: Choose Name as the field to update
steps.nextAction: Select the checkbox next to 'Name' and tap Proceed/Next
steps.tips: Name can be updated up to 2 times online. For more changes, visit an Enrolment Centre

steps.name: Enter New Name
steps.description: Enter the corrected or new name
steps.nextAction: Enter your correct/new name in the input fields
steps.tips: Enter the name exactly as it appears on your proof document. Avoid abbreviations

steps.name: Upload Name Proof
steps.description: Upload a supporting document proving your name
steps.nextAction: Select your proof type from the dropdown, then upload a clear scan/photo
steps.targetElement: Document Type dropdown, then Choose File button
steps.tips: Accepted: Passport, PAN Card, Voter ID, Marriage Certificate. File must be JPG/PNG/PDF under 2MB

steps.name: Review Name Update
steps.description: Review the name change before submission
steps.nextAction: Verify old and new name are correct, then tap Submit/Confirm
steps.tips: Double-check spelling. Name changes may take 7-15 days to process

steps.name: Confirmation & URN
steps.description: Success confirmation with tracking number
steps.nextAction: Note down or save your Update Request Number (URN) for future tracking
steps.tips: Take a screenshot! Track your name update status using this URN

subWorkflows.name: Update Biometrics
subWorkflows.description: Update fingerprints, iris scan, or photo on Aadhaar

steps.name: Biometric Update Information
steps.description: Information about biometric update process
steps.nextAction: Note: Biometric update requires an in-person visit to an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre. Tap 'Book Appointment' or 'Locate Enrolment Centre'
steps.targetElement: Book Appointment or Locate Centre link
steps.tips: Biometrics (fingerprint, iris, photo) cannot be updated online — you must visit a centre in person

steps.name: Book Appointment
steps.description: Book an appointment at an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre
steps.nextAction: Select your city/state and search for nearby Aadhaar Enrolment Centres
steps.tips: UIDAI recommends updating biometrics every 10 years. It's mandatory for children at age 5 and 15

steps.name: Select Centre & Time
steps.description: Choose a specific centre and appointment time
steps.nextAction: Select a centre from the list, pick a date and time slot, then tap Book
steps.targetElement: Book Slot / Select button for your preferred centre
steps.tips: Carry original Aadhaar card and valid ID proof to the centre

steps.name: Appointment Confirmation
steps.description: Appointment booking confirmation
steps.nextAction: Save or screenshot your appointment details
steps.tips: At the centre: Your fingerprints, iris scan, and photo will be re-captured. No documents needed beyond Aadhaar and ID proof

subWorkflows.name: Update Email
subWorkflows.description: Add or change email address linked to Aadhaar
requiredDocuments: No documents needed — email verification via OTP

steps.name: Select Email Update
steps.description: Choose Email as the field to update
steps.nextAction: Select the checkbox next to 'Email' and tap Proceed/Next
steps.tips: Email update does not require any document upload

steps.name: Enter New Email
steps.description: Enter your new email address
steps.nextAction: Enter your new email address and confirm it
steps.tips: Enter a valid email address you have access to — you may need to verify it

steps.name: Verify Email
steps.description: Verify the new email via OTP or link
steps.nextAction: Check your email for a verification code/link and enter it here
steps.targetElement: Verification code input or Verify button
steps.tips: Check your inbox and spam folder for the verification email

steps.name: Confirmation
steps.description: Email update confirmation
steps.nextAction: Your email has been updated successfully. You can close this page
steps.tips: Email updates reflect immediately on your Aadhaar records

subWorkflows.name: Download e-Aadhaar
subWorkflows.description: Download a digital copy of your Aadhaar card

steps.name: Download Aadhaar Page
steps.description: The e-Aadhaar download portal
steps.nextAction: Select 'Aadhaar Number' option and enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number
steps.targetElement: Aadhaar Number radio button and input field
steps.tips: You can also download using Enrolment ID or Virtual ID if you have them

steps.name: Verify OTP for Download
steps.description: Enter OTP to verify identity for download
steps.nextAction: Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number
steps.tips: The OTP is sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number

steps.name: Download e-Aadhaar PDF
steps.description: Download the e-Aadhaar PDF file
steps.nextAction: Tap 'Download' to save your e-Aadhaar PDF. The password is your PIN code
steps.tips: PDF password = first 4 letters of your name (UPPERCASE) + year of birth (e.g., RAHM1990)

subWorkflows.name: Check Update Status
subWorkflows.description: Track the status of a pending Aadhaar update request

steps.name: Status Check Portal
steps.description: The Aadhaar update status tracking page
steps.nextAction: Enter your Aadhaar number and URN (Update Request Number)
steps.targetElement: Aadhaar Number and URN input fields
steps.tips: You received the URN when you submitted your update request

steps.name: Enter CAPTCHA
steps.description: Solve the CAPTCHA for status check
steps.nextAction: Enter the CAPTCHA text and tap Check Status/Submit
steps.targetElement: CAPTCHA input field and Submit button
steps.tips: Enter the characters as shown in the image

steps.name: Update Status Result
steps.description: View the status of your update request
steps.nextAction: Review your update status. If completed, your updated Aadhaar is ready for download
steps.tips: If rejected, you may need to re-submit with better documents. If processing, check again in 2-3 days

metadata.department: UIDAI - Unique Identification Authority of India
securityNotes: Civora will NOT enter OTPs automatically
Civora will NOT store your Aadhaar number
All screen data is processed locally and not stored
